name: Curio Built-in Agent Text
purpose: The pages every agent Curio ships reads: the preamble, the knowledge pages it includes, one per feature of Curio, the tools, the reply protocol, the frames around what a run is given, the words of the block a run that writes code is given of its dataflow, the delegated runs' contracts, the title prompt, the keyword types, what a check tells a model when it refuses or corrects what the model wrote, the rules its prompts include, and the index of the shipped dataflows a run learns from. An agent names a page as curio:<path>.
